<span id="step-1-open-the-summary-report-in-the-reports-folder"></span>

<!-- qc-source-start -->
Open `reports/reportpreproc.txt` in a text editor. The example below shows how the report lists processing status.

| Subject | Task | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | rest | done |
| 2 | rest | missing |
| 3 | rest | missing |
| 4 | rest | done |

**Done** indicates that processing produced the expected outputs. Inspect their quality in the browser report. **Missing** indicates that an expected output is absent. Use section 3 to investigate the processing issue.

## Check for missing outputs {#step-1.1-check-for-missing-files-in-the-summary-report}

::: {.panel-tabset}
### All expected outputs are present

Continue to [4.4 Open the QC report](reports.qmd).

### Some expected outputs are missing

#### Rerun missing or failed subjects {#step-1.1.1-re-run-missing-or-failed-subjects}

Use [section 3 to check preprocessing](../check_run.qmd#check-preprocessing-outputs) and [rerun HALFpipe if needed](../check_run.qmd#rerun-halfpipe). Once the expected outputs are present, [open the QC report](reports.qmd).
:::
<!-- qc-source-end -->
